analytics-product.routing_summary: Interpret product behavior and metrics: conversion funnels, cohorts, retention, DAU/MAU, experiments, north-star metrics and product dashboards. Also covers event tracking; analytics-tracking specializes in instrumentation reliability.

analytics-tracking.routing_summary: Design, implement, audit and validate analytics instrumentation so events and conversions produce trustworthy decision data. Fix signal quality and measurement readiness before relying on dashboards.

architect-review.routing_summary: Assess existing system architecture or major design changes for scalability, resilience, maintainability and standards compliance; provide architectural findings and guidance.

architecture.routing_summary: Select a system design using requirements, constraints, pattern selection and trade-off evaluation; capture rationale in ADRs. Use architect-review to assess an existing design and architecture-decision-records for ADR practices.

architecture-decision-records.routing_summary: Create, maintain and review Architecture Decision Records: document technical choices, context, alternatives and rationale, including historical decisions. Use architecture for broader requirements and pattern-selection decisions.

code-review.routing_summary: Perform a code-change review for specification compliance, correctness, security and maintainability; produce severity-rated findings with evidence. Use requesting-code-review to arrange a separate reviewer.

code-reviewer.routing_summary: Perform detailed code analysis and review with actionable findings and verification. Reviewing code is the task; requesting-code-review instead prepares and dispatches an independent reviewer.

copy-editing.routing_summary: Polish existing marketing copy through focused editing passes while preserving its core message: clarity, concision, flow, proofreading and freshness. New page copy or substantial rewrites use copywriting.

copywriting.routing_summary: Write new marketing page copy or substantially rewrite headlines, value propositions, CTAs and page messaging. For focused edits preserving existing core message, use copy-editing.

debugger.routing_summary: Investigate and fix concrete errors, failing tests or unexpected behavior: capture evidence, isolate root cause, implement and verify a fix. Debugging execution expertise; systematic-debugging supplies the investigation workflow.

email-sequence.routing_summary: Plan email marketing sequences: welcome/onboarding emails, lead nurture, re-engagement, post-purchase, education and sales. Define triggers, timing, audience and conversion goals; in-app onboarding screens alone are outside this email workflow.

emails.routing_summary: Design and optimize lifecycle email programs: welcome/onboarding emails, drip campaigns, nurture, re-engagement and triggered sequences. This is email messaging and automation; in-app onboarding screens alone are outside that scope.

github.routing_summary: Fetch, list and inspect GitHub issues, PRs, Actions runs and logs through gh/API. CI status and log retrieval fit here; diagnosing the underlying code failure uses debugging.

pdf.routing_summary: Work with PDF files: extract text/tables, merge, split, rotate, watermark, fill forms, encrypt, OCR or create PDFs. Authored PDFs require an appropriate document pipeline plus rendered-page layout inspection; choose the authoring skill by document type.

requesting-code-review.routing_summary: Arrange an independent code review: prepare implementation context, requirements and base/head revisions, dispatch a reviewer, then act on findings. This coordinates review rather than performing the analysis itself.

superpowers:receiving-code-review.routing_summary: Evaluate received review feedback against codebase reality before implementing suggestions: understand, verify technical correctness, respond and test each change. Use when review comments already exist.

superpowers:requesting-code-review.routing_summary: Arrange an independent code review with precisely crafted requirements, implementation context and base/head revisions. Dispatch a reviewer using bounded context rather than session history; evaluate findings before continuing.

superpowers:systematic-debugging.routing_summary: Root-cause investigation workflow before proposing bug fixes: reproduce, gather evidence, form and test hypotheses, then implement. Applies to errors, failed tests and unexpected behavior.

systematic-debugging.routing_summary: Root-cause investigation workflow before proposing bug fixes: reproduce, gather evidence, form and test hypotheses, then implement. Applies to errors, failed tests and unexpected behavior.
